subject.title: docs(clickclack): add CSRF 403 troubleshooting for managed proxy (#98362)

question: Should the official ClickClack guide publish a temporary managed-proxy rebuild warning while the installer lifecycle issue remains open?
rationale: The patch is technically safe, but only the ClickClack/installer owner can confirm whether rebuilding an unmanaged proxy is a supported public recovery path or temporary field workaround.

options.title: Publish a scoped known-issue note
options.body: Keep the PR, refresh it onto current `main`, and qualify the note as an installer-specific symptom while linking the canonical issue for supported recovery updates.

options.title: Wait for durable installer repair
options.body: Hold the documentation until installer versioning, Doctor repair, or an authoritative rebuild command is available.

options.title: Document in installer ownership
options.body: Move the recovery guidance to the installer/tooling documentation and leave the channel guide linked only to that supported procedure.

recommendation.title: Publish a scoped known-issue note
recommendation.body: Keep the PR, refresh it onto current `main`, and qualify the note as an installer-specific symptom while linking the canonical issue for supported recovery updates.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner across ClickClack product behavior and OpenClaw installer boundaries.
